carry_to(spot["x"], spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=spot["object_long_axis_yaw"])
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat()
check("blue_pen", "green_case")

- After the program blue_pen is offset [-0.0008, 0.0017] m from the centre of green_case ([0.0001, 0.0019] m along / across the zone's long axis) (the zone half size along / across its long axis is [0.0764, 0.0214]); inside_zone=False, resting=False, gripper_holding=False.
